notes: Source: 南方电网 95598 information API (areaCode 060000), monthly notice PDFs (text) 2025-11..2026-10.

TOU per 黔发改价格〔2023〕481号 (eff 2023-08-01; official scan on 95598.csg.cn): 峰 10-13、17-22; 平 8-10、13-17、22-24; 谷 0-8; all months, no 尖峰/深谷; applies to 两部制 users (table prints TOU prices only for 两部制 rows). 峰/谷 = 平 ± 60%.

Exception 2026-02: the official February 2026 notice (note 2) prints 峰 10-11、17-22; 平 8-10、11-13、15-17、22-24; 谷 0-8、13-15 (481号 allows dynamic adjustment; no separate adjusting document is cited) — stored as a rule for 2026-02 only, source = that notice.

黔发改价格〔2026〕47号 (2026-01-22, official scan on 95598.csg.cn): from 2026-02-01 only 上网电价(代理购电价格) + 线损 float (输配、系统运行费、基金 no longer float); from 2026-03-01 两部制 users trading directly on the wholesale market (and retail pass-through volumes) no longer follow regulated TOU. Periods unchanged.
